result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: the top-right avatar/action button renders as an empty grey circle, horizontal carousel items and filter chips are hard-clipped at the screen edge with text cut mid-word, the two favourite (heart) buttons use inconsistent styling, and the last restaurant card is abruptly truncated by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The circular control in the header (top right, next to 'DELIVER TO') is an empty light-grey circle with only a red notification dot — the icon or avatar image failed to render, so its purpose is unclear and it has no accessible label.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon/avatar (with a fallback initial or placeholder glyph) and add an accessible label such as 'Notifications' or 'Account'.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped at the viewport edge and its title reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the name look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek so the next card is clearly partially visible, and apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a max width to card titles.

issues.description: The bottom 'pizza' restaurant card is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation bar; no name, rating or delivery info is visible, so the section end looks like a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height and ensure list items are not partially rendered at the fold, or scroll-snap card boundaries.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular background with dark outline, while the pizza card uses a dark/transparent circle with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to one treatment (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white icon) across all cards for consistency and legibility over any image.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is clipped at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent partial chip with edge padding or add a fade/gradient mask to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The green promo banner contains large overlapping translucent circles that are cropped oddly at the right and bottom edges, reading as a stray graphic artifact rather than intentional decoration.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes to the banner's rounded corners and reposition them so they don't collide with the 'Order now' button or edges.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet WCAG AA contrast against the white background.
